overview.sectionSubtitle: Transitioning from fragmented campus tools to a unified academic operating architecture.
overview.problemText: Universities struggle with data silos spanning physical paper rosters, informal group chats, and detached course folders. This fragmentation obscures student attendance trends, leads to abrupt academic exclusions due to lack of early intervention, and leaves students blind to how their coursework connects to industry requirements.
overview.solutionText: StudySync delivers a real-time, institutionally compliant backbone: tamper-proof Dynamic QR check-in, real-time tracking against university exclusion limits (75%), and an ML curriculum classifier that aligns course electives with market skill benchmarks.

features.sectionSubtitle: A modular architecture engineered across every phase of student and faculty operations.

items.desc: Centralized lecture repository, readings, and verified announcements with granular section-level permissions.

items.desc: Real-time midterm and coursework gradebook with cumulative GPA impact projections.

items.title: Unified Academic Calendar

items.title: Institutional Push Notifications

items.title: Career Pathway Alignment
items.desc: Natural Language Processing models that evaluate syllabus outcomes against contemporary job market roles.

items.title: Elective Recommendation Engine

items.title: Curriculum-Bound AI Learning Tools

items.title: Internship & Opportunity Center

items.title: Prerequisite Graph Visualizer

workflows.sectionSubtitle: Seamless orchestration connecting user interfaces to backend policy validation engines.

items.title: Lecture Publishing & Material Ingestion
steps: Faculty uploads lecture deck or syllabus document
System indexes content and connects to course question bank
Automated broadcast notification sent to enrolled students
Structured summary generated via curriculum AI model
Self-testing practice questions unlocked on student portal

items.title: Dynamic QR Attendance Verification
steps: Professor launches session displaying 15-second rotating QR
Student scans token using authenticated mobile client
Cryptographic hash validated against current active window
Attendance record logged into database with immutable timestamp
Exclusion risk recalculated and live percentage updated

items.title: Early Risk Detection & Intervention
steps: Student absence breaches institutional warning boundary
Rule engine evaluates college bylaws against historical attendance
Official advisory notification dispatched to student portal
Flag escalated to academic advisor dashboard for intervention
Student guided to review absences before final exclusion cutoff

items.title: Elective Recommendation & Constraint Filtering
steps: Student designates target industry career track
Filter removes completed courses and checks prerequisites
Inference pipeline scores remaining courses by relevancy
Candidate courses ranked balancing credit hours and difficulty
Recommended schedule presented for academic advisor sign-off

items.title: Exam Scheduling & Adaptive Study Planning
steps: Instructor schedules midterm or final examination
Synced across all enrolled students' centralized calendars
Automated reminder triggers scheduled leading up to exam date
Event flagged in active 'Next Milestone' dashboard module
Personal study routine dynamically recalibrates review sessions

ai.sectionSubtitle: Purpose-built models engineered to support academic advising, with strict human oversight.
ai.mlDesc: A multi-label natural language processing model trained on university course descriptions, syllabi, and ABET accreditation outcomes to compute semantic alignment with industry career tracks with calibrated probability scores.
ai.mlInput: Course descriptions, learning outcomes, textbook topics, syllabi
ai.mlOutput: Target career tracks mapped with statistical confidence scores
ai.mlReview: Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop review by academic department chairs

architecture.sectionSubtitle: A multi-tier, modular design engineered for high availability, auditability, and institutional scale.

layers.title: Presentation & Experience Tier
layers.desc: Ultra-lightweight Single Page Application delivering high rendering speed, zero-dependency CSS, and seamless RTL/LTR bilingual switching.

layers.title: Security, Identity & API Gateway
layers.desc: Rigorous security governance utilizing RS256 JWT tokens, granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and rate-limiting safeguards.

layers.title: Core Domain Microservices
layers.desc: Autonomous microservices handling course catalogs, rotating QR verification, university bylaw rules, and ML inference pipelines.

layers.title: Data Persistence & Cache Tier
layers.desc: ACID-compliant relational storage ensuring transcript integrity, coupled with sub-millisecond in-memory cache for attendance check-ins.
